rawContent: We hit the road to report on community wealth building stories throughout the country: From Entrepreneurship in St. Louis, MO, to electoral organizing in Uniontown, AL, and community wealth building on urban farms in Detroit, MI. #BlackVotersMatter #BLM  https://t.co/yEgkhgUqip https://t.co/3kOzwkbkkb

On Aug 1, Mike Brown graduated from high school. On Aug 9, he was murdered by police officer Darren Wilson. 

4 year laters, we remember him and are in solidarity with the people of St. Louis in demanding police accountability and building equitable structures. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/ICQ1sJmwwt
